scientific_integrity: The analytic four-step matrix limit and Green–Kubo finite-time identity establish the claims; enumerations and numerical Fourier powers are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Obstacle-free classical probability walk; uniform initial direction is required for the closed position characteristic function. Joint critical scaling is n(1-p_n) -> finite lambda; no claim for coherent quantum dynamics, walls, quenched obstacles, or a uniform two-parameter limit. Global novelty is not certified.
title: A four-phase Poisson crossover at the deterministic edge of a chiral lattice walk
